metadata.question: Did forest cover in the Bobiri Forest Reserve, Ghana, decline between 2003 and 2023?

data.exec_msg:
Initial forest area (2000, >30% cover): 73.38 sq km
Forest area lost (2003-2023): 17.48 sq km
Decline relative to initial cover: 23.82%
Evidence of forest loss found between 2003 and 2023.
A
